rows.heading: ONGC Medical Examination of Employees Rules, 2026 (Part 4)
rows.quote_snippet: NOTE: For women candidates, a female medical officer will conduct the examination. If a female medical officer is not available at the work center, the examination may be conducted by a male medical officer in the presence of a female nurse or attendant.

rows.heading: ONGC Medical Examination of Employees Rules, 2026 (Part 28)
rows.quote_snippet: In case of female candidate, medical examination will be carried out by a female medical officer. In case of non-availability of female medical officer, a Staff Nurse or a Female Attendant will be present when female candidates are examined by male medical officer.
